subject: Leadership sprint readout + QBR logistics and decision asks
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership sprint readout + QBR logistics and decision asks

Team —

Quick readout from last week’s sprint and three asks ahead of the QBR packet deadline (Friday EOD):

Wins
- Infra: Autoscaler tuning dropped P95 inference latency by ~18% on standard workloads; perf team validated across p99 sequences (attached perf matrix).
- Sales/BD: Acme PoC completed server-side integration; early throughput matches our dedicated profile.
- Console: New trace view landed for token-level cost attribution (internal flag off by default).

Risks
- Dedicated capacity: We’re seeing a 12% delta in memory footprint for some quantized 8-bit builds on the A100 nodes; if that holds we may need to delay a few canaries.
- QBR deck: Missing updated Acme MAP slide + legal signoff on the procurement timeline.

Asks (actionable)
1) Laura — confirm whether Legal can sign the procurement timeline by Thursday AM so we can include in the deck.
2) Jonas — recommend one fallback model variant (size/quantization) we can list for SLA mitigation; need text by EOD Thu.
3) Karthik — please confirm the rehearsal slot Thursday 4pm PT works for you and Peter from Sales Ops.

Attachments: QBR-draft-v1.pdf (slide deck draft), Acme-MAP-2028.xlsx (mutual action plan)

I’ll consolidate replies and push a final deck to the Drive at noon Friday.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategy Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership sprint readout + QBR logistics and decision asks

Thanks Hannah — great distillation. Quick notes: 

- For fallback model variant, recommend offering the 13B int8-q4 model. It preserves quality on our eval suite with a 9% lower token cost and is already validated on the same kernel path as the 70B quantized run. I’ll draft two bullets for the slide with expected perf/cost deltas.

- On the memory delta: infra; can we share the offending model binaries and the exact sequence lengths where the spike shows up? I’ll pull the kernel logs with the perf team today.

Jonas
Director, Serving Runtime

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership sprint readout + QBR logistics and decision asks

Hannah/Laura —

Appreciate the update. A couple items from Acme side:
- Procurement timeline: our finance lead is good to sign once Legal confirms a standard data retention clause. I can push that internally if legal confirms the exact wording.
- We validated the PoC on our side and are on track for a pilot kickoff Aug 6; Sales Ops asked whether Redwood can provide a short note on SLA fallback options (what model we’d fall back to and expected latency ranges).

I attached a short internal note (not included in thread) and updated the MAP spreadsheet with our projected purchase window.

Thanks,
Sarah
Head of AI Integrations, Acme Corp

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, marketplace@cloudpartner.com
Date: Thu, 26 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership sprint readout + QBR logistics and decision asks

Team — consolidating next steps and owners below (final deck will incorporate these; I’ll hand off to Laura for the legal line):

Decisions / Owners
- Legal signoff on data retention clause — Laura (due Thu 07/26, 11:00 AM PT)
- Fallback model variant text & perf bullets — Jonas (due Thu 07/26, 5:00 PM PT)
- Rehearsal confirmation (Thu 4:00 PM PT) and Sales Ops attendee — Karthik (confirm now)
- Final deck upload (public Drive link + HubSpot attachment) — Hannah (I’ll upload by Fri 12:00 PM PT)

Interim notes:
- Infra team: Jonas, please include a short note explaining the memory delta and whether a kernel switch is required; if it is, flag risk to canaries in the slide.
- Acme ask: I’ll draft the SLA fallback blurb and share with Sarah for signoff before the rehearsal.

Thanks all — if we can close the Laura/Jonas asks by EOD Thu, we’re set for Friday’s packet.

Best,
Hannah
